from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """The profit metric extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/certificate code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    profit_metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the profit metric as written in the report")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric profit value; negative if loss")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
